loginHeadline: Know what needs attention before service starts.
loginIntro: FiScore Admin is the owner and admin workspace for restaurant groups: monitor site health, manage access, set operating standards, and keep billing in one secure web console.
loginFeatureSites: Track health inspection history, open findings, and site readiness.
loginFeatureTeam: Invite managers and control who can see or act at each location.
loginFeatureStandards: Publish templates that keep checks and training consistent.
loginFeatureBilling: Manage subscription and billing from the business console.
signInLinkSent: A secure sign-in link was sent to {{email}}.
requestFailed: The request failed. Please try again.
setupWorkspaceIntro: Create the tenant workspace for your restaurant group or business. You can add the first site next.
billingPlaceholder: Stripe subscription management will plug into this page in Phase 2.
templatesPlaceholder: Tenant-level audit and training template management will build on this area.
analyticsPlaceholder: Cross-site analytics will mature here as aggregate functions are added.
accessDenied: This web console is available to tenant owners and admins.
noRecentActivity: Team access changes, invites, and admin updates will appear here once work starts.
addSiteHeadline: Add a restaurant site to FiScore
addSiteIntro: Start by searching public restaurant records. If you cannot find the location, create a manual site.
addSiteHelpBody: Search first when the restaurant has public inspections. Create manually only when the location is new or missing from public records.
linkPublicRecordHelp: Best for existing restaurants with inspection history.
createManualSiteHelp: Use only for new locations or records not available in search.
searchPublicRecordsHelp: Search by restaurant name, city, or ZIP. Choose the exact matching location before importing.
searchingPublicRecords: Searching public restaurant records. This can take a few seconds.
searchResultsHelp: Choose the exact location to import inspection history into this tenant.
noMatchingRestaurantsHelp: Try a broader name, city, or ZIP. If this location is not in the public record source yet, create a manual site without importing public inspection history.
manualSiteIntro: Manual sites are useful for new or private locations. This setup will not import public inspection history.
manualSiteNoImportTitle: No public inspection history will be imported
manualSiteNoImportBody: The site will still be available to the mobile app for internal checks, audits, users, and training.
confirmLinkedSiteBody: Confirm this is the exact restaurant location. FiScore will add the site and import available public inspection history.
confirmManualSiteBody: Confirm the site details before creating it without public inspection import.
completeRequiredFields: Complete restaurant name, street address, city, and ZIP before continuing.
manualValidationBody: Complete the highlighted fields below before continuing.
searchFailedTitle: We could not search public records.
searchFailedBody: Check your connection and try again. You can also create a manual site.
linkSiteFailedTitle: We could not link this site.
linkSiteFailedBody: The restaurant may already be linked, or you may not have permission to add sites.
createSiteFailedTitle: We could not create this site.
createSiteFailedBody: Review the site details and try again.
updateSiteFailedTitle: We could not save this site.
updateSiteFailedBody: Review the highlighted fields and try again.
deleteSiteFailedTitle: We could not delete this site.
deleteSiteFailedBody: The site was not deleted. Check your permission and try again.
siteLinked: Site linked and inspection history imported.
editManualSiteHelp: Update the site details shown to admins and the mobile operations app. Public record details are only editable for manual sites.
deleteSiteWarningBody: This permanently removes the site and all inspections, audits, violations, attachments, assignments, and activity under it. This cannot be recovered.
emptyMembers: No active members yet. Invite managers and staff once your first site is ready.
emptyInvites: No invitations are waiting. New invites will appear here until accepted.
dashboardHeadline: Your restaurant operations at a glance
dashboardIntro: Start here each morning to see which sites need attention, whether violations are moving, and whether the right people have access.
pendingReviewHelper: Submitted responses waiting on manager review.
sitePerformanceHelp: Inspection and violation snapshots from each active location.
recentActivityHelp: Access and team changes made by admins.
emptySitesBody: Link a public restaurant record to import inspection history, or create a manual site and connect records later.
sitesIntro: Add restaurants, import public inspection history, and keep location details current for the frontline app.
sitesListHelp: Each site is shared with the mobile operations app.
teamHeadline: Put the right people in the right sites
teamIntro: Invite admins, managers, auditors, and staff, then limit access to all sites or selected locations.
inviteUserHelp: Invited users sign in with the same Firebase account model used by the mobile app.
deactivateMemberBody: This user will lose access to the tenant admin console and mobile app for this tenant. Their historical activity will remain.
cancelInviteBody: This invitation will no longer be valid. You can send a new invite later if needed.
activeMembersHelp: Active users who can access this tenant.
violationsHeadline: Track every open issue across sites
violationsIntro: Review public inspection findings and internal check issues across the tenant without taking the frontline workflow away from the mobile app.
activeViolationsHelp: Open or in-progress issues across all sites.
awaitingReviewHelp: Submitted fixes waiting for manager approval.
unassignedViolationsHelp: Active issues with no owner assigned.
searchViolations: Search title, code, site, or detail
emptyViolationsBody: Change the filters, or add/import site data to surface public inspection and internal check findings.
readyForReviewBody: Resolution submitted and waiting for approval.
emptySourceDetails: Source information will appear here as imports mature.
question: Question
emptyViolationDetails: No additional violation detail is available yet.
resolutionHelp: Capture the completed correction and any helpful details.
emptyResolution: No resolution has been submitted yet.
proofHelp: Photos or short videos that show the issue and completed fix.
emptyProof: No proof has been added yet.
trainingHeadline: Monitor assigned training across every site
trainingIntro: See active, overdue, and completed training assignments while frontline teams complete training in the mobile app.
searchTrainingAssignments: Search title, teammate, site, linked violation, or status
emptyTrainingAssignmentsTitle: No training assignments in this view
emptyTrainingAssignmentsBody: Change the filters, or assign training from the mobile app when a site or violation needs coaching.
trainingHelp: Targeted coaching to help prevent this issue recurring.
emptyTraining: No training is assigned for this violation.
notesHelp: Team updates without changing the fix response.
auditsHeadline: Review internal checks across every site
auditsIntro: See which checks are complete, which are in progress, and which created violations while frontline teams continue the work in the mobile app.
auditsInspectionsHeadline: Review checks and public inspections across every site
auditsInspectionsIntro: See FiScore internal checks and imported health department inspections in one oversight workspace while frontline teams keep execution in the mobile app.
publicInspectionsIntro: Track public inspection history, findings, reports, and related violations across every linked site.
publicInspectionsHelp: Imported health department inspections across active sites.
withFindingsHelp: Public inspections that include findings or imported violations.
reportsAvailableHelp: Inspections with a report URL or copied tenant report.
completedAuditsHelp: Finished internal checks across active sites.
inProgressAuditsHelp: Checks started but not completed yet.
auditsWithViolationsHelp: Completed checks that created follow-up issues.
searchAudits: Search site, check, result, or person
searchPublicInspections: Search site, type, status, source, or grade
emptyAuditsBody: Change the filters, or complete checks in the mobile app to populate audit history.
emptyPublicInspectionsTitle: No public inspections in this view
emptyPublicInspectionsBody: Public inspections appear after a site is linked to imported health department history.
inspectionReportHelp: Reports can come from public inspection sync or tenant upload. Tenant reports are opened first when available.
emptyInspectionDetails: Inspection details will appear here as checks are completed.
emptyReportDetails: No report metadata is available for this inspection yet.
workSummaryHelp: Summary of answered checklist items and outcomes.
publicInspectionSummaryHelp: Summary of imported findings, violation follow-up, and report availability.
emptyAuditViolations: This audit did not create any violations.
publicInspectionViolationsHelp: Imported findings and violations associated with this public inspection.
emptyPublicInspectionViolations: No imported violations are associated with this inspection.
emptyResponseSummary: No checklist items were marked as needing attention.
